limitations: First8 mixed reference is evaluated by the frozen reference suite in separate riff/comp slices, not whole-score dropped count.
Bossa and Jazz recognition remain below the original quality gates.
Unknown harmony and missing voicings remain warnings, never filled from fabricated truth.
Actual guitar trials and independent rhythmic annotation have not been completed.
